import sys

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    it = iter(data)
    out_lines = []
    while True:
        try:
            n = int(next(it))
            s = next(it)
        except StopIteration:
            break
        max_out = 0
        cur_out = 0
        inside_words = 0
        inside = False
        word_start = True
        for c in s:
            if c == '(':
                inside = True
                word_start = True
                cur_out = 0
            elif c == ')':
                inside = False
                cur_out = 0
            elif not inside:
                if c == '_':
                    cur_out = 0
                else:
                    cur_out += 1
                    if cur_out > max_out:
                        max_out = cur_out
            else:  # inside parentheses
                if c == '_':
                    word_start = True
                elif word_start:
                    inside_words += 1
                    word_start = False
        out_lines.append(f"{max_out} {inside_words}")
    sys.stdout.write("\n".join(out_lines))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
